description: Shared conflict-agreement fixture (ticket 51). The same set of planned sections goes through findConflicts in src/core/conflicts.ts and find_conflicts in src-tauri/src/core/conflicts.rs; both must report exactly these conflicts, in this order. The set covers: an overlap on one day of two (S1 x S2, Monday only), per-block day specificity (S2 x S3 clash on Friday, S3 x S4 on Saturday), back-to-back blocks that merely touch (S1 x S4 on Monday, S4 x S5 on Monday), and the duplicate-section input: S5 repeats S1's identity (2923/384) with an overlapping block, which must yield no self-conflict on either side. Order comes from the shared pair loop: sections in input order, pairs as (i, j>i), blocks in section order.
